task: Edit this internal email for teams preparing a fictional exhibition opening. Make the three submission routes easy to follow in about 60–100 words, using bullets if useful. Preserve the shared deadline without inventing a central approval or forwarding process.
input: Please send all your opening information to the treasurer by Monday. This includes headcounts, projector connections and exhibit titles. The treasurer will approve everything and pass it on. To keep things simple, no team should contact the people handling the individual arrangements.

facts.text: Each team should send its opening headcount to the catering coordinator.
Projector-connection requirements should go to the technical desk.
Exhibit titles should go to the programme editor.
All three submissions are due by Monday.
The treasurer has no collection or approval role in this process.

forbidden_additions: A central treasurer approval or forwarding stage.
A requirement to send every type of information to every recipient.
An invented form, email address, or more precise deadline.
preserve: Different recipients for catering, technical needs, and programme text.
A directly usable set of actions rather than merely advice to communicate better.
